noise_windows.band_rule: first-sample age >= 1.50 s and last-sample age <= 2.45 s after the previous physical onset
noise_windows.tiling: contiguous non-overlapping windows from the first admissible sample of each allowed stretch (train/cal/eval); stride 1 inside allowed stretches (reference)

T.rule: unchanged: largest T in {20,16,12,10} meeting all budgets in all four dev subjects with >= 10% margin, applied to the partition actually used (PARTITION_CENSUS.json)
T.note: T = 12 met the rule under the run-blocked partition but not under the interleaved one (sub-03/04 training 1743/1716 < 1760)

signal.scaling_rule: original centres and width x T/20 = x 0.5
signal.filter_basis: generate the bump family on a 1100 Hz grid over [-2, 2] s, apply the identical preprocessing FIR (mne.filter.create_filter(None, 1100, 1.0, 40.0, method='fir', phase='zero', fir_design='firwin')), sample every 12th point from t = 0; R2 asserts the FIR hash equals the one raw.filter uses in /ceph/dwong/meg_env, and the basis geometry (principal cosines 0.7238/0.0867/0.0464, norm 0.817)
signal.spatial_templates: unchanged rule and template_windows_s [[0.08,0.13],[0.14,0.20]], computed from the evoked field over a fixed 20-sample window (evoked_T = 20), independent of T
signal.channel_selection: unchanged statistic over the fixed 20-sample window (evoked_T = 20), so the 24 channels are unchanged
signal.filter_rationale: pipeline consistency: the injected response is shaped and anti-aliased as a real response; NOT stop-band removal (filtered family keeps 1.39 % / 4.95 % of energy above 40 Hz)
signal.channels_assert: R2 asserts the selected channels equal the sealed D1 list per dev subject

reference_metric.definition: divisor-n covariance of all stride-1 in-band windows of the ref-role gaps (all runs), centred at their mean; no shrinkage
reference_metric.role: fit metric of the ref arm, scoring metric (clean_ref), G3 whitening, signal trace normalisation, D3 noise covariance (M = K + I with K = S_ref^-1/2 R_s S_ref^-1/2)

G1.retest: unchanged once-only automatic retest (drop the noisiest channel) runs on the unshrunk matrix before any E1 or route-A decision; a retest gives C = 23 (d = 230) for that subject, disclosed
G1.failure: a subject that still fails G1 after the retest is excluded under E1 (supersedes revision 1 "route A on a G1 failure"); no alternative metric or regularisation is searched

G2.G2R_reference_transport: m_train = tr(W S_train)/d, S_train = covariance of train-role windows (all runs) centred at the train-role mean (divisor n); no inflation correction (null m_train 1.012 at a = 0, 1.018 at a = 0.5, 1.034 at a = 0.75)
G2.group_definition: fixed eigenvector groups of the replicate's or subject's own S_ref (ascending variance, 50/40/10 % of d); g = tr(Q' W^(1/2) S_eval W^(1/2) Q)/tr(Q' W^(1/2) S_train W^(1/2) Q)
G2.pass: G2-R and all five G2-S statistics inside the band
G2.replaces: retired as gates: mean whitened eigenvalue and MP-spread criterion (spread_ratio_max 2) against the shrunk reference, both reported descriptively; the physical trace ratio is KEPT as a gate (eval vs train roles, RD-10b); g_top10 and the other group ratios are added, not substituted
descriptive: generalised eigenvalue table S_eval vs S_ref, read against its expected null range (DESIGN §3)
G2.not_gated: isotropy of the whitened noise: holds by construction up to the reference-estimation term (size reported by D3-S); group-wise train/ref ratios are biased by eigenvalue spreading at O(sqrt(d/n_eff)) and are descriptive

G3.estimand_and_threshold: unchanged: positional whitened mean energy, strict < 2.06604, min n 30
G3.statistic: E_cr = mu^T W mu - B/(B-1) * sum_b u_b^T W u_b / n^2, u_b = sum_{i in b}(x_i - mu); clusters b = (run, block) of the role; W = S_ref^-1 (RD-10a)
G3.slots: one window per gap at each tiling position; 3 roles x 8 positions at T = 10; rposition identical to position under the band (computed, counted once)
G3.naive_debias: mu^T W mu - tr(W S_pos)/n reported descriptively for every slot
G3.dependence_screen: per subject f_hat = sum over eval and cal slots of the cluster variance term / sum of the naive term; f_hat > 2.64 (= f at gap AR 0.5) -> G3 not calibrated -> G3 failure under E1
G3.calibrated_range: slot statistic: null claimed for gap AR a <= 0.5 (endpoint through L4); a = 0.75 descriptive. Screen: 2.64 is f(0.5) for complete 11-gap blocks; with the real gap and response geometry f(0.5) is 2.53-2.65, so the screen flags no replicate at a <= 0.45, about half at a = 0.5 and all at a >= 0.55. Subject-level G3 (slot or screen, as E1 counts it) is calibrated for a <= 0.45; a subject with gap dependence near a = 0.5 or above is excluded by design

E1.dev: a dev subject failing G1, G2 or G3 is excluded; D3/D4 continue iff >= 3 of 4 dev subjects pass; otherwise STOP (route A)
E1.confirmation_min: n_min = max(8, smallest n <= 12 at which the D4 power rule passes); frozen at D4
E1.budget_rule: m_hi = the largest c in [1024, 768, 512] with every dev calibration pool >= 1.1 c (census gives 768); P and m_hi over all four dev subjects, as the kit; n_eval 500; R2 unit test: census pools -> 768
E1.n_min_sd: the D4 power rule at n_min uses the pilot between-subject SD at its one-sided 80 % upper limit (chi-square, df = included dev subjects - 1)
E1.motivation: changed after R0 showed in-band run drift in sub-03/04, fixed before any gate value under the R1 rules (commit 40737cf precedes 9379425 and 696a2f7)

d3.noise_model: primary: M = K + I in S_ref-whitened coordinates (option ii, RD-10c); the whitened noise scale c rescales the S4.3 constants (N*+1 proportional to c); expected c ~ 1.013 (stride-1, independent gaps; ~1.02 at gap AR 0.5), upper bracket 1.14 (stride-T)
prestated_reasons_for_a_PZ2_miss_added: whitened noise scale c != 1 (N*+1 scales by c; expected c ~ 1.013)
reference-estimation tilt of the ref arm (learner maximises tr(P(K+N)), risk wants tr(P(K-N))), order d/n_eff, direction: larger N*
run-mixture non-Gaussianity of the pooled roles (G5 on the pooled training role)
d3.D3S_descriptive: reported with predictions.json before any fit, never a gate or reading: (1) delta = a_hat - D_W at population level; (2) N*_pred recomputed with M = K + N_sim through the general path; (3) simulated tr(N_sim)/d next to the observed m_train; 50 simulated reference estimates per subject from the control generator with the real stride-1 window geometry
d3.other: trace_K_target unchanged in value over d = 240, so N* roughly scales with (d - k) relative to T = 20; the theta rule absorbs it. B_dagger is multiplied by lambda_min(Sigma_K^1/2 S_ref^-1 Sigma_K^1/2): PZ1 exact zero and monotonicity unaffected, the B_dagger interval widens. G4 compares the flip-flop Kronecker MLE with the unshrunk S_ref (descriptive). D8 secondary readout is not run for this submission.
d3.D3S_budget: runs in R4 with content unchanged (50 estimates per subject, all rows); 16 workers, wall-clock budget 8 h (R2-A preflight projects about 96 CPU-h, about 6 h at 16 workers) (RD-11b)

controls.generator: source: the sealed UNSHRUNK all-window reference covariance of each dev subject (T = 20), as R0-e used it, rebuilt from the stored divisor-n moments; temporal factor: Toeplitz-averaged temporal partial trace, AR(10) by Yule-Walker on lags 0-10 (lags 11-19 reported as a fit check); spatial factor: spatial partial trace normalised to trace C; per gap, a stationary Gaussian process on that gap's band stretch aligned at the band start, response exclusions applied after generation; gap AR Y_g = a Y_(g-1) + sqrt(1-a^2) xi_g at equal offsets from the band start, reset at run starts; windows cut with the real gap counts, band, response gaps, interleaved roles and stride-1 reference; separable by construction (disclosed)

laws.L6: L2 plus independent per-run lognormal factors (top-10 % group sd 0.2, global sd 0.1) along the generator's population eigenvectors of the top-10 % group (Kronecker product of the fitted temporal and spatial factors), in every window of every role, the stride-1 reference included
laws.L7: as L6 but per (run, block) with sd 0.1 on both targets

G2 detection (endpoints): C2 eval top-10 % group x1.5 along the replicate's S_ref eigenvectors of that group (the groups G2-S uses), every eval window
C3 eval bottom-50 % group x1.5, same definition
C4 eval middle-40 % group x1.5, same definition
C5 smallest eigenvector of the ref-role spatial partial trace, variance x8 at every time sample of every eval window
G3 detection (endpoint): C7 locked mean 4x threshold at eval position 0, unjittered
descriptive: C9 locked mean 4x with onset jitter uniform 0-200 ms
C12 loudest physical direction x1.5 (physical-trace sensitivity)

controls.endpoint_unit: law x cell, pooled over the four dev-subject shapes (800 replicates)
controls.rules: one-sided Clopper-Pearson: null claims pass iff <= 22 of 800 fail (upper bound <= 0.05); detection claims pass iff >= 745 of 800 detect (lower bound >= 0.90)
controls.descriptive_rates: L5 and L7 for all gates; run-blocked G2-S detection of L6 (expected ~0.91 any run, ~0.36 run 6); dependence-screen flag rates under L4/L5; C8-C12; subject-level G3 exclusion (slot or screen) for every law; L2-L5 quantiles of the generalised-eigenvalue extremes (the reading range)
controls.preflight: required in R2 on Deepthought before the run; measures the control campaign against the cap and D3-S cost for planning; D3-S is not under the control cap (RD-11a)
controls.failure_rule: if any of the 35 endpoint claims fails, R2 stops and returns to design; no threshold, law, cell or statistic is changed in response to a control outcome
controls.budget_scope: the 6 h x 4-worker cap applies to the R1-d control campaign only (RD-11a); R2-A measured 3.217 h
controls.geometry_input: exact per-gap band stretches and final-gap lengths exported from sub-01..04 events.tsv and FIF header (recording-length) metadata, no signal samples (RD-11c)

pre_R2_readonly_check_R0e.what: stored T = 20 in-band records of runs 3-6, pseudo-roles from PARTITION_RULE.assign_roles with the real per-run gap counts; W = inverse of the sealed unshrunk all-window reference
pre_R2_readonly_check_R0e.G3_proxy: R0-a computation under W on pseudo-role partitions train/cal/eval (runs 3-6); run-blocked stored partitions reported descriptively
pre_R2_readonly_check_R0e.G2S_proxy: m_eval/m_train and the three group ratios between eval-role and train-role windows of runs 3-6 (role-mean centred, divisor n)
pre_R2_readonly_check_R0e.order: run only after this CONFIG is committed; its hash is cited by the R0-e report

partition.run_offset: block b of run r gets cycle[(b + r - 1) mod 6]

partition.guard: first gap of every non-initial block is unused
